programs.title: Me and My tourette's
programs.desc: Tourette's syndrome, which manifests itself in involuntary movements and vocal tics, can lead to social exclusion of people affected by it.Participants of a special camp in Victoria hope to improve their functioning.Viewers meet three patients with Tourette's syndrome.Among them is a girl struggling with the difficulties of everyday life, a recently diagnosed man and a teenager who dreams of working in the police.Despite many difficulties, each of them tries to live like other representatives of society.

programs.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programs.desc: Antarctica is the coldest and windiest continent.The climate here is harsh, and only the toughest can survive.From Weddell seals crushing the ice with their teeth, to colorful starfish covering the seabed hidden under the ice.Penguin chicks may lose their lives when confronted by killer whales and leopard seals.Meanwhile, starfish and huge worms line the seabed as a feeding spectacle takes place on the surface.Life comes to Antarctica because the ocean surrounding the continent is extremely rich.Thousands of penguins, seals, albatrosses and over a hundred huge whales feast on the krill schools.Unfortunately, the local waters are warming, and as the temperature increases, the future of the local fauna and flora looks more and more uncertain.
